scope: Proposition 5.1 (Differential inequality for the envelope) of the manuscript “Uniformization of complete Kähler manifolds with positive bisectional curvature” (preprints/Uniformization-of-complete-Kahler-manifolds-with-positive-bisectional-curvature-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 338 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2960f958368ee0ab), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 31-32. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose that a smooth real function φ touches v from below at (y∗, s∗), where 0 < s∗ < T. In holomorphic cotangent coordinates write W = ∂ ¯ ∂Y φ(y∗, s∗) = ( A B B∗ C ) , C > 0. 31 There is a Hermitian form K on the horizontal coordinate space such that K ≥ 0, K ≥ A − BC−1 B∗ , ∂sφ(y∗, s∗) ≥ tr(C𝖳 K). (5.1) The transpose is the tangent–cotangent contraction in these coordinates. In particular the statement applies to lower tests translated in a fixed cotangent coordinate chart; its contraction has constant coefficients.
